title: Which Greek god are you? Free Greek mythology quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Greek god quiz: answer 12 questions to find which of the 12 Olympians you are, from Zeus, Hera and Poseidon to Athena, Apollo, Artemis, Aphrodite and Hermes. No sign-up.
lede: Are you a born leader like Zeus, a strategist like Athena or the life of the party like Dionysus? Answer 12 questions about your strengths, your temper and your dream life to find your Olympian.
about: In ancient Greek myth, the twelve Olympians ruled the world from Mount Olympus: Zeus, king of the gods; Hera, goddess of marriage; Poseidon of the sea; Demeter of the harvest; Athena of wisdom and strategy; Apollo of music, light and prophecy; Artemis of the hunt and the wild; Ares of war; Aphrodite of love and beauty; Hephaestus of the forge; Hermes, the messenger; and Dionysus, god of wine and festivity. (Some lists include Hestia, goddess of the hearth, in place of Dionysus.)

Your result names your god and shows your scores for all twelve. The myths are thousands of years old and belong to everyone; this quiz was written for cv.cm and is just for fun. If you liked it, the Percy Jackson godly parent quiz on this site takes a more modern angle.

faq.a: All twelve Olympians: Zeus, Hera, Poseidon, Demeter, Athena, Apollo, Artemis, Ares, Aphrodite, Hephaestus, Hermes and Dionysus.

faq.q: Is one god rarer than the others?
faq.a: No. Every god appears in the same number of answers, once in each answer position, so each one is equally likely.
Hades lived in the underworld rather than on Mount Olympus, so he is not usually counted among the twelve Olympians. He may join in a later update.

faq.q: Is this the same as the Percy Jackson quiz?
faq.a: No. That quiz finds your godly parent from the Percy Jackson books; this one compares you with the gods of the original Greek myths.

zeus.name: Zeus
zeus.body: You are a natural leader with a big presence. People look to you to decide, and you rarely shy away from responsibility. Use your power fairly, and keep that famous temper in check.

hera.name: Hera
hera.body: You are loyal, dignified and deeply committed. You take promises seriously and protect your family and friends fiercely. Let go of grudges that only weigh you down.

poseidon.name: Poseidon
poseidon.body: You are passionate, powerful and as changeable as the sea. Your moods run deep and your feelings are big. Find calm waters when you need them, and others will follow your tide.

demeter.name: Demeter
demeter.body: You are nurturing, patient and generous. You help people and ideas grow, and you know good things take time. Look after yourself as well as you look after everyone else.

athena.name: Athena
athena.body: You are wise, strategic and cool under pressure. You think three steps ahead and win battles with your mind. Let your heart have a say now and then.

apollo.name: Apollo
apollo.body: You are creative, bright and truthful. Music, art and ideas come naturally to you, and you light up a room. Share your gifts, and don't let perfectionism dim your shine.

artemis.name: Artemis
artemis.body: You are independent, adventurous and fiercely protective. You love the wild and don't need anyone's permission. Guard your freedom, but let a few loyal friends in.

ares.name: Ares
ares.body: You are brave, competitive and full of fire. You never back down from a challenge. Channel that energy into goals worth fighting for, and know when to walk away.

aphrodite.name: Aphrodite
aphrodite.body: You are charming, romantic and magnetic. You bring beauty and warmth wherever you go, and people are drawn to you. Love yourself as much as you love others.

hephaestus.name: Hephaestus
hephaestus.body: You are a maker: hard-working, skilled and quietly brilliant. You'd rather build something real than talk about it. Your work speaks for you, so let it be seen.

hermes.name: Hermes
hermes.body: You are quick, clever and always on the move. You can talk your way into or out of anything, and you connect people wherever you go. Slow down sometimes; not everything is a race.

dionysus.name: Dionysus
dionysus.body: You are fun-loving, free-spirited and the life of the party. You help people relax and enjoy themselves. Enjoy the celebration, and make sure the people around you are enjoying it too.
